title: RunResult
description: Result of one run. Returned by the runner, the hub and the Vercel fallback, and sent to the browser in runFinished.

outcome.description: compile_error: goose check rejected the program and nothing ran. exited: the program ended on its own (see exitCode). timeout: stopped at the time limit. output_limit: stopped after the output cap. killed: stopped by the memory or process limit.

exitCode.description: Program exit code when outcome is exited, otherwise null.

diagnostics.description: Errors and warnings from goose check --diagnostics json. Empty when there are none.

truncated.description: True when stdout or stderr was cut at the output cap.

durationMs.description: Wall time inside the container, check and compile included.

text.description: The whole message as a terminal would show it.

diagnostics.message: expected a value of type i32, got const u8[:]
